speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have the roll, sir. I have read what is written in the margin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Weep here, Nick. It sits where the farewell begins. The Queen is at the gate. The tears are the first thing the yard should have.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can weep, sir. I will not weep before the scene has given me cause.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cause is the parting. Let the face say so before the third line does.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: On Thursday the cause came three lines later. I wept when it came. The margin asked for the tear at the top, and the lines had not yet given me a reason.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thursday was a first hearing. If thou waitest those three lines today, the yard will have decided thou art cold.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Let him finish the reason, Will. He is being exact, and you are being quick.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Grief first, then the speech that earns it. If the speech comes first, the grief looks learned. A person who already knows does not wait to be told, and the night she has had is the reason, and the night is... no. The night is not on the roll. I am giving thee a reason the scene does not contain.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I can play the roll, sir. I cannot play the night that is not on it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You heard that fail, Will. Halfway. It was fluent, and then it left the page.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He is right about Thursday, Will. The tear landed when the cause landed. I need to know whether my cue is a tear or a line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thy cue is a line. The tear was my guess. I do not like a guess once I have heard it fail.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will give it without the margin, if you want the difference. I will not give you a tear I have not earned.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Give it him without the margin, and let's hear.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I forgot to fidget.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Less to look at, and more to believe. That is the note, Dick. Thou wert still.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Do you hear it, Will, or are you still fond of the ink in the margin?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear it. The margin was a guess. He knew better.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I wept where the cause came, sir. Three lines after the place you marked. Where it was on Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am striking the direction, Nick. I am not striking thee. Stay as thou art.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hast put a hole in the guess. My cue is cleaner if I am not waiting on a tear that will not come.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The instruction changes. The boy does not. Say it back, so we do not grow a new margin by noon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The direction is out. He weeps when the scene gives him cause, and not before. The jaw made every consonant a negotiation, and the guess was still the wrong one.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: If the words are written in again, I will ask you before I obey them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ask me. I will say the same. N. S. knew better, and I am going to put that where I can see it, before I am clever again.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Write it on thy tables, not on my roll. The end is where it was. Thou hast moved thy face. Thou hast not moved my cue.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: That will do for the gate. The king is this afternoon, the second time. We are not going to rehearse Gaunt's death on the back of a boy's good sense.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gaunt is mine this afternoon, and he is done by the middle. The morning was the gate. The gate is settled.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then I will see thee later, in a different death. Do not write on a roll between now and two of the clock.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will write on the tables. The eleven lines at home are not this play, and they are not coming up the field.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Two deaths are enough for one day. His, this afternoon, in the middle. The Queen's, at the gate, on the cause and not before it. Leave Verona at the lodging.
